subject: general
question: Simplify x⁹ × x⁵ × x⁻⁴ × x⁰ × x⁻⁶.
solution:
**Given:**

x9 × x5 × x-4 × x0 × x-6

**Concept used:**

xa × xb = x⁽a ⁺ b⁾

xa ÷ xb = x(a - b)

**Calculation:**

x9 × x5 × x-4 × x0 × x-6

⇒ x9 × x5 × 1/x⁴ × 1 × 1/x6

⇒ x9 × x × 1/x6

⇒ x9 × 1/x5

⇒ x4

**∴ The required answer is x4**.
